thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — release train PAUSE starting 18:00 UTC today for a coordinated hotfix + infra safety sweep. No new merges to main or deploys to prod until 23:00 UTC unless you have an approved exception.
Maya: Why — we saw a small latency regression on the text-gen fleet after yesterday's kernel tweak and there's a security patch that needs kernel-level rollout. Combining windows to avoid churn.
Maya: TL;DR: freeze 18:00–23:00 UTC, canaries paused, emergency hotfixes allowed via exception process.
Devops-bot: Deploy gate enabled at 1765432200. All scheduled prod pipelines will be paused; CI will still run but deploy jobs will be marked HOLD.
Sara: If I have a critical bugfix for the embeddings service, what's the path?
Maya: @Sara — file an exception and ping #eng-releases with the exception ID. Include impact, test plan, and rollback steps. We'll triage in the 18:05 call. Exception form: https://go/redwood/rel-exceptions
Chad: Are canaries for v3.5 model updates also blocked? I had a tiny canary running.
Devops-bot: Canary traffic is reduced to 0% for the release window. Existing canaries will be frozen; do NOT force-promote.
Zhou: For folks running local staging canaries, keep them running; just don't push to prod. This helps reproduce the latency spike.
Alex: What about Dedicated customer rollouts that were scheduled this evening?
Maya: @Alex — Dedicated rollouts are deferred; customer-facing migrations will be rescheduled. If there's a contractual need, contact PM/CS and we'll handle on a case-by-case exception.
Leah: Is there a recommended rollback command if a hotfix goes sideways?
Zhou: Rollback snippet for runtime: ```
# rollback to last stable tag
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:stable-20260405
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime
```
Maya: Ops will be on standby in the 18:00 war room. Join here: https://meet.redwood/warroom-release. We'll do a readout at 23:15 UTC with follow-ups.
Sara: Thanks — will open exception if needed. :thumbsup:
Chad: Noted. I'll cancel my non-critical canary. :eyes:
Devops-bot: If you opened an exception, add the tag `freeze-exception` to the PR and include the exception ID in the description.
Maya: Appreciate the quick responses. One ask — freeze covers main->prod only. Feature branches and demos are fine as long as they don't touch prod infra.
Leah: Copy. Will coordinate rollback playbook with oncall.
Maya: Closing note: keep messages in this thread for the window so we have an audit trail. I'll post updates if the window changes. :locked_with_key:
